```{r setup}
rm(list=ls())
setwd("/Users/caitlinwaterworth/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-UniversityofBath/YM_combined_analysis/EU_combined_analysis/scripts")
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(cowplot)
library(ggtext)
library(Hmisc)

load("gba_functions.rda")
```

```{r load}
## Consensus half-life fold change -- SE < 0.75, c1 fitting
df_consensus <- read_tsv("../output_tables/df_WT_consensus_hl_fc.txt",
                         show_col_types = FALSE)

## Vijjamarri et al. 2023 -- Dcp2 and Xrn1 deletion steady-state RNA-seq
## CAVEAT: deletion mutants in YPD, not G1-arrested AID depletion
## transcriptional compensation likely confounds steady-state signal
df_vijjamarri <- read_tsv("../tables/df_vijjamarri_gba.txt",
                           show_col_types = FALSE)

## Chappleboim et al. 2022 -- Not1 and Xrn1 AID depletion time course
## CAVEAT: AID depletion in exponentially growing cells, not G1-arrested
## 60 min time point limits but does not eliminate transcriptional compensation
df_chappleboim <- read_tsv("../tables/df_chappleboim_gba.txt",
                            show_col_types = FALSE)

cat("Consensus genes:", nrow(df_consensus), "\n")
cat("Vijjamarri genes:", nrow(df_vijjamarri), "\n")
cat("Chappleboim genes:", nrow(df_chappleboim), "\n")
```

```{r join}
df_gba <- df_consensus %>%
  dplyr::left_join(df_vijjamarri,  by = "gene_id") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(df_chappleboim, by = "gene_id")

cat("Genes after join:", nrow(df_gba), "\n")
cat("Genes with Vijjamarri data:",
    sum(!is.na(df_gba$log2FC_dcp2D_vs_WT)), "\n")
cat("Genes with Chappleboim data:",
    sum(!is.na(df_gba$log2FC_not1_60min)), "\n")
```

```{r s1_dcp2}
## Section 1 -- Half-life FC vs Dcp2 deletion signature (Vijjamarri)
## R = -0.243 -- Dcp2 targets do NOT gain more stability in large cells
## CAVEAT: deletion mutant confounded by transcriptional compensation

pA <- scatter_binned_gba(df_gba,
                         x_col     = "log2FC_dcp2D_vs_WT",
                         y_col     = "WT_hl_fc",
                         x_lab     = "log2 FC, Dcp2 deletion (Vijjamarri)",
                         y_lab     = "log2 half-life FC (large/small)",
                         point_col = col_small,
                         ylim      = c(-2.5, 2.5),
                         xlim      = c(-4, 4)) +
  labs(tag = "A")

pA
ggsave("../figures/GBA_dcp2_correlation.png",
       plot = pA, width = 6, height = 6, dpi = 150)
```

```{r s2_xrn1_vijjamarri}
## Section 2 -- Half-life FC vs Xrn1 deletion signature (Vijjamarri)
## R = -0.141 -- negative, likely artefact of transcriptional buffering

pB <- scatter_binned_gba(df_gba,
                         x_col     = "log2FC_xrn1D_vs_WT",
                         y_col     = "WT_hl_fc",
                         x_lab     = "log2 FC, Xrn1 deletion (Vijjamarri)",

                         point_col = col_large,
                         ylim      = c(-2.5, 2.5),
                         xlim      = c(-5, 2)) +
  labs(tag = "B")

pB
ggsave("../figures/GBA_xrn1_vijjamarri_correlation.png",
       plot = pB, width = 6, height = 6, dpi = 150)
```

```{r s3_not1}

```

```{r s4_xrn1_chappleboim}

## R = 0.133 -- weakly positive, most biologically consistent result

pD <- scatter_binned_gba(df_gba,
                         x_col     = "log2FC_xrn1_60min",
                         y_col     = "WT_hl_fc",
                         x_lab     = "log2 FC, Xrn1 depletion (Chappleboim)",
                         y_lab     = "log2 half-life FC (large/small)",
                         point_col = col_large,
                         ylim      = c(-2.5, 2.5),
                         xlim      = c(-0.5, 2.5)) +
  labs(tag = "D")

pD
ggsave("../figures/GBA_xrn1_chappleboim_correlation.png",
       plot = pD, width = 6, height = 6, dpi = 150)
```

```{r s5_not1_geneset}
## Section 5 -- Gene set comparison: Not1-sensitive vs other
## p = 0.308 -- not significant

pE <- violin_comparison_gba(df_gba,
                             flag_col        = "not1_sensitive",
                             value_col       = "WT_hl_fc",
                             x_lab           = "",
                             y_lab           = "log2 half-life FC (large/small)",
                             sensitive_label = "Not1-sensitive\n(n=622)",
                             other_label     = "Other",
                             ylim            = c(-2.5, 2.5)) +
  labs(tag = "E")

pE
ggsave("../figures/GBA_not1_geneset.png",
       plot = pE, width = 5, height = 6, dpi = 150)
```

```{r s6_xrn1_geneset}
## Section 6 -- Gene set comparison: Xrn1-sensitive vs other
## p < 0.001 -- significant, median FC 0.876 vs 0.799

pF <- violin_comparison_gba(df_gba,
                             flag_col        = "xrn1_sensitive",
                             value_col       = "WT_hl_fc",
                             x_lab           = "",
                             y_lab           = "log2 half-life FC (large/small)",
                             sensitive_label = "Xrn1-sensitive\n(n=303)",
                             other_label     = "Other",
                             ylim            = c(-2.5, 2.5)) +
  labs(tag = "F")

pF
ggsave("../figures/GBA_xrn1_geneset.png",
       plot = pF, width = 5, height = 6, dpi = 150)
```

```{r s7_sensitivity_groups}
## Section 7 -- Sensitivity groups: Both / Not1 only / Xrn1 only / Neither

n_not1      <- sum(df_gba$not1_sensitive, na.rm = TRUE)
n_xrn1      <- sum(df_gba$xrn1_sensitive, na.rm = TRUE)
n_both      <- sum(df_gba$not1_sensitive & df_gba$xrn1_sensitive, na.rm = TRUE)
n_not1_only <- n_not1 - n_both
n_xrn1_only <- n_xrn1 - n_both
n_neither   <- nrow(df_gba) - n_not1 - n_xrn1 + n_both

cat("Not1-sensitive only:", n_not1_only, "\n")
cat("Xrn1-sensitive only:", n_xrn1_only, "\n")
cat("Both:", n_both, "\n")
cat("Neither:", n_neither, "\n")

df_gba <- df_gba %>%
  dplyr::mutate(sensitivity_group = case_when(
    not1_sensitive & xrn1_sensitive ~ "Both",
    not1_sensitive                  ~ "Not1 only",
    xrn1_sensitive                  ~ "Xrn1 only",
    TRUE                            ~ "Neither"))

pG <- ggplot(df_gba %>% dplyr::filter(is.finite(WT_hl_fc)),
             aes(x = sensitivity_group, y = WT_hl_fc,
                 fill = sensitivity_group)) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 0.4, trim = TRUE) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.12, outlier.shape = NA,
               linewidth = 0.5, fill = "white") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Both"      = col_A,
    "Not1 only" = col_small,
    "Xrn1 only" = col_large,
    "Neither"   = "grey70")) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-2.5, 2.5)) +
  labs(x   = "",
       y   = "log2 half-life FC (large/small)",
       tag = "G") +
  cell_theme_gba +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

pG
ggsave("../figures/GBA_sensitivity_groups.png",
       plot = pG, width = 7, height = 6, dpi = 150)
```

```{r assemble}
## Row 1: A B C D (scatter correlations, equal width)
## Row 2: E F G spacer (violins + sensitivity groups)

row1 <- (pA | pB | pC | pD) +
  plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1, 1, 1))

row2 <- (pE | pF | pG | plot_spacer()) +
  plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1, 2, 1))

caption_text <- paste0(
  "(A) Half-life fold change (log2 large/small) versus mRNA accumulation after Dcp2 deletion ",
  "(Vijjamarri et al. 2023, n = ", sum(!is.na(df_gba$log2FC_dcp2D_vs_WT)), "). ",
  "Negative Spearman R suggests Dcp2 targets do not preferentially gain stability in large cells. ",
  "Caveat: deletion mutant in replete media, transcriptional compensation likely confounds signal. ",
  "(B) Half-life fold change versus mRNA accumulation after Xrn1 deletion (Vijjamarri et al. 2023). ",
  "Negative R consistent with widespread transcriptional buffering in xrn1 deletion strains. ",
  "(C) Half-life fold change versus mRNA accumulation after Not1 AID depletion at 60 min ",
  "(Chappleboim et al. 2022, n = ", sum(!is.na(df_gba$log2FC_not1_60min)), "). ",
  "Near-zero R indicates CCR4-NOT deadenylation does not drive size-dependent mRNA stabilisation. ",
  "(D) Half-life fold change versus mRNA accumulation after Xrn1 AID depletion at 60 min ",
  "(Chappleboim et al. 2022). Weakly positive R is the most biologically consistent result. ",
  "AID depletion limits transcriptional compensation relative to deletion strains. ",
  "(E) Half-life fold change in Not1-sensitive (log2 FC > 0.75 at 60 min, n = 622) versus other ",
  "genes. Wilcoxon test p = 0.308. Not1-sensitive genes do not show significantly different ",
  "size-dependent stability changes. ",
  "(F) Half-life fold change in Xrn1-sensitive (log2 FC > 1.5 at 60 min, n = 303) versus other ",
  "genes. Wilcoxon test p < 0.001. Xrn1-sensitive genes show significantly larger stability ",
  "increases in large cells (median FC 0.876 vs 0.799). ",
  "(G) Half-life fold change stratified by decay pathway sensitivity. Both (red) = sensitive to ",
  "both Not1 and Xrn1. Not1 only (purple). Xrn1 only (pink). Neither (grey). ",
  "All correlations Spearman. Binned mean shown in scatter plots A-D. ",
  "Datasets: Vijjamarri et al. 2023 eLife (deletion mutants, YPD). ",
  "Chappleboim et al. 2022 NAR (AID depletion, exponentially growing cells).")

caption_text <- gsub(";", ".", caption_text)

p_caption <- ggplot() +
  geom_textbox(
    aes(x = 0, y = 1, label = caption_text),
    hjust      = 0, vjust = 1,
    width      = unit(24, "inch"),
    size       = 8,
    lineheight = 1.6,
    fill       = "white",
    colour     = "black",
    box.colour = NA) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA))

panel_plots <- row1 / row2 +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1))

final <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  panel_plots,
  p_caption,
  ncol        = 1,
  rel_heights = c(10, 4))

ggsave("../figures/GBA_figure_panel.png",
       plot   = final,
       width  = 24,
       height = 20,
       dpi    = 150)

cat("Saved GBA_figure_panel.png\n")
```
